title_suffix: fine source-prime padding (PR1786) at the free epsilon -> 1 point, with gauge-free interiors and the radix-distributed union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
summary: Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below, with fine source-prime padding (PR1786, chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa, via Tim Trudgian's prime theorem; vendored) which makes the grouped chirp guard beta + 2 xi - 2 < 1, the fractional-shift gauge-free interiors with accretive shallow circuits (PR1758, outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md), the radix-distributed union schedule with per-visit tag work, and the explicit Strassen boundary. New here: epsilon is a free parameter of the PR1786 ledger (every row holds for every 1-epsilon > 1e-64), so the explicit point is epsilon = 1 - 2e-64, beta = 1 - 6e-64, giving kappa = 0.00167975495612554452133567099392070257..., 3.4e-67 below the supplier's complex saving q, hence the ceiling of any outer of this form (outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md). 57 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls, an independent balance derivation with an epsilon sweep, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and the gauge-free identity checks are regenerated; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses and the cited prime theorem; the fine-padding lemmas (PR1786 is a draft) and the composition need independent review; asymptotic margins are 2e-64.
credits: PR1786 (chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa): fine source-prime padding, its proof and checks, vendored under vendor/pr1786; Tim Trudgian: effective prime number theorem (arXiv:1401.2689). PR1673 (Vlado Vojdanovski, with AI assistance): capped phase-cell fusion outer construction, its proof and exact evidence, vendored under vendor/pr1673. PR1758 (IdeaOuter and contributors): fractional-shift gauge-free interiors, accretive shallow-circuit lemma, per-visit tag accounting. Jeremy Kothe and contributors (PR1731 ledger lineage, radix-union schedule), LeverRank (independent schedule simulation), Gohberg, Semencul, Kailath, Kung, Morf, Bitmead, Anderson, Pan (structured Toeplitz-like algorithms of the retained alternative), Francois Le Gall et al. and Chafik Boukhalfa (PR1699).
